title: Fix silent omissions in replay-planner inventories
body:
## Summary

The research replay planner could silently omit an unreadable package, or every package if `research/` was unreadable. Replace error-suppressing glob discovery with one explicit shallow scan and manifest lookup. Readable opt-in selection stays the same.

```diff
- unreadable inventory -> exit 0, empty or partial replay matrix
+ unreadable inventory -> exit 1, no matrix or GitHub output appended
```

Adds public-CLI regressions and a scoped [evidence note](docs/research/replay-planner-inventory.md). [Canonical claim and finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2955).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new tests fail for unreadable `research/`, an unreadable first package, and an injected scan error. Real CLI reproduction exits zero and appends `count=0` or an incomplete `count=1`.
  **After:** all nine focused tests pass on CPython 3.12.15 and optimized 3.14.8. Failure emits no stdout and leaves existing GitHub output unchanged; restored permissions recover the literal complete matrix.
- `python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`: 147 tests pass, seven platform skips. Permission tests ran on macOS arm64; a platform-independent injected-error control also passes.
- Original/fixed selection agrees on all 1,101 registrations for a shared-runner change and on unrelated, local-package and shared-input examples. Selected source-binding baseline and exact committed-byte checks pass. Ruff E/F/B has no new diagnostics; existing diagnostics and limits are documented. Separate internal review found no actionable issue.
- Base and final checked canonical main: `afc158a25ef3e0bd80de81d1eb5339f0dace118e`, priority revision 5. Final complete overlap scan covers 278 open PRs, 2,385 closed PR bodies and 1,650 Discussion records. A planner/unreadable search finds only the canonical claim; unpublished work and arbitrary diffs remain outside coverage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. A focused runner change with regression tests.

**Blast Radius:** shared. The runner change selects all registered packages for existing CI replay. Readable manifests retain their current selection; an unreadable inventory now stops planning. Native Windows execution and hosted-CI success are not claimed. Concurrent filesystem changes, mathematical acceptance and selected-supplier cold replay remain outside this discovery fix. The selected frontier and frozen evidence are unchanged.
